<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission and Supreme Court:</strong> The ECI informed the Supreme Court that voters excluded in specific states can reapply using enumeration forms without facing prosecution.</li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary diplomacy:</strong> Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla is scheduled to inaugurate the Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians Conference in Bengaluru on November 17.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
